Return one Hertwill brand by ID, including its marketing material links (logo, cover, and marketing_assets_url for downloadable banners/creatives). Use when you have a brand ID and need its assets or profile. Do NOT use to look up a brand's shipping rates (use get_brand_shipping_price_lists) or to browse a brand's products (use list_products). Returns {id, name, slug, description, logo, cover, marketing_assets_url}. No auth required.
